rules.name: Advisory never blocks
rules.statement: An advisory never stops a build; only a gate does.
rules.risk: A build stopped by a matter of judgement teaches its author to ignore every finding the tools print.

sites.why: fails a build on gate findings alone, however many advisories were printed
passes one fragment, counting its advisories, when no gate finding was found
states that the component count check advises, and that a justified exception stays a judgement call

rules.name: Clean is the narrowest verdict
rules.statement: A build is clean only when every gate ran and no advisory is left open.
rules.risk: A gate that was skipped would read as a gate that passed, hiding a broken map behind a green report.

sites.why: calls a build incomplete when a gate that should have run did not
calls a build advisory when only advisories were found, which is not clean
exits with failure on an incomplete build, so a skipped gate cannot read as a pass
stops the closing sequence at the first failing step, and names the steps that never ran

rules.name: Silence by recorded reason
rules.statement: An advisory the operator decides to live with is silenced only by a reason recorded in the map.
rules.risk: Without one place to record the reason, the same advisory fires on every build until people stop reading.

sites.why: says a durably justified exception is recorded in the map and silences its own advisory
forbids rewording the map to dodge an advisory, and asks for a recorded reason instead
matches a finding against the recorded reasons, so only a recorded one is passed over

rules.name: Recorded reasons must name a finding
rules.statement: A recorded reason is refused unless it names a finding the checks really read.
rules.risk: An operator would believe an advisory was answered while it keeps firing, and nothing would say so.

sites.why: refuses a reason filed under a heading no check ever reads
refuses a reason that answers no finding, and writes nothing at all
reads nothing from a reason listing several things when one of them is not a finding

rules.name: Every silence is announced
rules.statement: Every advisory a recorded reason silenced is still counted out loud in the build's report.
rules.risk: A silence nobody can see reads the same as having no findings, so a map can look clean by suppression.

sites.why: adds a line saying how many advisories the recorded reasons silenced, and on which elements
names on every build the code a written exclusion removed from every check
reports a reason that failed to parse instead of dropping it in silence
collects a line that tries to be a reason and answers nothing, so the build reports it
keeps the announcement of a silence out of reach of any recorded reason

rules.name: Some findings carry no excuse
rules.statement: A finding whose only honest answer is a fix cannot be silenced by a recorded reason.
rules.risk: An escape here would let a map record its own gaps as acceptable, which the checks exist to stop.

sites.why: holds the findings no recorded reason may silence, each beside the reason it cannot
refuses any way to record a use case as deliberately left untold
tells an operator that a recorded reason cannot answer a finding about a code link's shape

rules.name: Every advisory says where to answer it
rules.statement: An advisory must say where the operator records the reason for living with it.
rules.risk: An advisory with nowhere to answer it is waved through forever, so the check changes nothing.

sites.why: fails when an advisory leaves the reader nowhere to record the decision
prints beside the advisories the command that records a reason the checks will find
